provenance: SYNTHETIC envelope, MEASURED reason TEXT, INFERRED key NAME AND LOCATION. The reason string is the live sample quoted in infra/terraform/modules/batch/main.tf (evidence-build rev 32, 2026-08-02, 'OutOfMemoryError: container killed due to memory usage'), which is why that retry rule keys on on_reason and NOT on on_status_reason. Exit 137 is the SIGKILL convention. WHAT IS NOT MEASURED, said plainly: that a container reason arrives in a Step Functions Cause spelled `Reason` and at the TOP level. The measured P1 Cause's top-level Container has sixteen keys and no reason field in either casing, so this fixture's key name is a guess that was, until 2026-09-07, written to match the rule that reads it. Its two siblings batch_oom_lowercase_reason and batch_oom_attempt_reason_only carry the other two spellings for exactly that reason.
why_it_is_here: THE ORDERING PROOF. An OOM-killed container ran and exited, so its StatusReason is the ordinary 'Essential container in task exited' and the ran-to-an-exit arm would happily call it a blocked SOURCE. Every infra arm must therefore precede it. This document is caught twice over -- by the signal-exit arm (137 >= 128), which reads a MEASURED field, and by the PascalCase reason arm, which reads the inferred one -- and the roster pin test_an_oom_is_infra_however_batch_spells_the_container_reason asserts that the first of those is sufficient on its own.
